## 🔒 Security & Quality Checklist

Before submitting this Pull Request, please ensure you have completed the following:

- [ ] I have verified that no private API keys, passwords, or personal credentials are included.
- [ ] My code adheres to the project's **GPLv3** open-source license.
- [ ] All new functions and changes pass local syntax and validation checks (`python -m py_compile`).
- [ ] I have not modified core security parameters without prior discussion with the maintainers.
- [ ] Any new feature or bug fix includes corresponding documentation or comments.
